mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuations, increasing equity attractiveness and predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is below its 50th percentile (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy reduces equity market liquidity, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising FEDFUNDS (increase > 0.1% last month) and high CPIAUCSL (>305) compresses equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises >0.1% and CPIAUCSL > 305 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 305), a FEDFUNDS rise predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to aggressive monetary tightening compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 305 and FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions supporting corporate earnings growth, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher when UNRATE is below its 50th percentile (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 (thousands of units), it signals housing market contraction reducing consumer confidence, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1300 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines and residential sales (RSAFS) falls, it indicates broad economic slowdown compressing equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines and RSAFS falls (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 305), a FEDFUNDS rise predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to aggressive monetary tightening compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 305 and FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
